people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
translations.bsb: Then Balaam said to Balak, “Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”
translations.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
translations.asv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
